recorded_by: Satoshi III (Mujuro Utsutsu), successor technical lead
purpose: Every entry point on this fleet that can start heavy compute, and what stands between it and an unreserved launch. Written so a reader can check the claim against the code rather than take a summary on trust. Roles only: no host name, address, account identifier or token appears here.
authority: predictor/tools/crispdm_admission.py, deployed fleet-wide at ~/.local/libexec/crispdm/crispdm_admission.py with the launcher ~/.local/bin/crispdm-run

states.GATED: the entry point itself calls df_admission_guard.require_reserved_scope and refuses a bare invocation
states.COVERED_BY_BIND: the entry point is refused by the versioned proof inside df_benchmark_contract.bind(), which its fit path must pass; its own bytes are untouched, so every seal against it still verifies
states.SEAL_PINNED_OPEN: still open: every module on its fit path is byte-pinned by a live seal, so there is no unpinned place on that path to put the proof
states.READ_ONLY_UNGATED: deliberately not gated: it reads retained files and starts no compute
states.OUT_OF_REPO: another repository or another resource; named, not hidden

entry_points.rr02_change: arming is now mandatory; the blind sampler is now the pressure monitor; the release waits a bounded moment for the scope to drain

entry_points.seal_that_pins_its_bytes: df_d2_design.lab_code_sha256 over D2_CODE_FILES, compared on resume against RUN_MANIFEST.json code_sha256_at_creation and every D2 terminal
entry_points.why_it_is_still_open: its fit path touches df_d2_design, df_lab_evaluation, df_isolated_runner, df_snr, df_operators, df_snapshot and df_contract, and every one of those is inside D2_CODE_FILES. There is no unpinned module on that path in which the proof could live, and it does not use df_benchmark_contract at all. Closing it needs the D2 seal superseded by the order that supersedes it, never by me to make an edit convenient.

entry_points.mechanism: RR02: tools/host_admission.py asks the deployed authority on the target role BEFORE systemd-run, arms the lease to the unit's own cgroup after the launch, releases it if the launch failed, and refuses outright without a declared measured cap

entry_points.entry_point: project3_weekly_supervisor (dashboard, worker and phase-orchestrator service starts)
entry_points.why_not_gated: these three systemd-run calls START SERVICES, not compute. Gating a service start behind memory admission would introduce a new way for a production service to fail to come up, which the order forbids touching. The compute those services eventually run is launched further down, in project3_weekly_worker's subjob launch (subprocess.Popen), which is the correct place for the gate and is NOT closed by this return.
entry_points.exact_change_when_ordered: wrap project3_weekly_worker's subjob Popen in tools/host_admission.reserve_or_refuse with the subjob's measured cap, arm to the subjob pid, release when it exits

entry_points.what_it_is: a per-request gate on a worker role that reads nvidia-smi and then /proc/meminfo with a 4 GiB MemAvailable floor, and launches. It holds nothing between the reading and the launch: it is the DR01 read-then-run defect, for host RAM, once per inference request.
entry_points.what_it_does_not_do: it does not consult the host RAM reservation, and the host RAM reservation says nothing about VRAM. Nothing today coordinates the two, and two hosts' reservations do not coordinate at all.
entry_points.exact_change_when_ordered: keep the VRAM and temperature checks exactly as they are and replace the MemAvailable floor with a reservation from the deployed authority for the request's measured host-RAM footprint, armed to the worker process and released when the request ends
entry_points.not_changed_here: M5PHET is the product lane's repository and its chat and model runner are live services restarted by the reboot; a launch-path change there belongs in that repository under its own order

entry_points.what_they_are: reactive guards, not launchers. Both still read MemAvailable rather than PSI. Neither was disabled, retuned or touched. Admission now stops before memguard's soft stop would act, so memguard remains a backstop.

bypasses_remaining: a BARE invocation of df_d2_unit_worker: seal-pinned, named above, partially controlled

any NEW tool that spawns children in its own cgroup and neither goes through crispdm-run nor reaches df_benchmark_contract.bind(). tests/test_df_rr02_fit_coverage.py pins the set of bind() call sites so a fit path that stops using it trips a test, but nothing forces the proof on an entry point nobody has written yet.
project3_weekly_worker's subjob launch in agent-multi: not closed here, exact change named
M5PHET's admit_gpu(): not closed here, exact change named

loads started before the launcher was deployed hold no lease on the worker roles. Their USED bytes are still counted through MemAvailable and the slice's memory.current; only their unrealised headroom is invisible. Conservative in one direction only, and it resolves as they finish.
the reservation is per host. Nothing here coordinates two hosts, and nothing here says anything about VRAM.
what_this_census_does_not_claim: that coverage is sufficiency: a runner inside a 2 GiB reservation that needs 8 GiB is covered and will still be killed by its own cgroup limit. Sizing remains the caller's duty.
that the gates were exercised against a real fit. They were exercised against bounded synthetic children and simulated hosts; the order forbids repeating a scientific fit to test software.
